faqs.question: What is the attendance policy at University of Layyah?
faqs.answer: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each registered course to be eligible for final term examinations. Attendance falling below 75% results in an automatic course drop or 'F' grade due to short attendance.

faqs.question: What grading system and passing criteria does UL follow?
faqs.answer: University of Layyah follows the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) aligned with HEC guidelines. The maximum possible CGPA is 4.00, and the passing mark threshold for any individual subject course is strictly 50%.

faqs.question: When are midterm and final term examinations conducted?
faqs.answer: Midterm examinations are held in the 8th week of the ongoing semester, while Final term examinations take place in the 16th week.

faqs.question: What are the general discipline rules on campus?
faqs.answer: Ragging, smoking, political profiling, and union strikes are strictly banned inside university premises. Carrying and wearing a valid Student ID Card at all times is mandatory for campus entry.

faqs.question: What is the fee for the student hostel at University of Layyah?
faqs.answer: The annual hostel fee for students is 18,500 PKR (excluding dynamic monthly mess charges). Seats are allocated strictly on a merit and distance basis.
faqs.note: Not backed by a dedicated section in the data (no student-hostel section; transport-card scope/terms conflict with Transport Dept description and bus routes).

faqs.question: What is the transport card fee and what routes are covered?
faqs.answer: The transport card fee is 3,500 PKR per semester. Buses operate on routes connecting Layyah City, Chowk Azam, Fatehpur, and Karor Lal Esan directly to the university campuses.
faqs.note: Not backed by a dedicated section in the data (no student-hostel section; transport-card scope/terms conflict with Transport Dept description and bus routes).

faqs.question: When is the Sports Gala scheduled and what games are included?
faqs.answer: The Main Sports Gala 2026 is scheduled for November 12, 2026, featuring inter-departmental tournaments in Cricket, Football, Badminton, Table Tennis, and Athletics.

faqs.question: What are the Main Campus Cafeteria timings?
faqs.answer: The Main Campus Cafeteria (adjacent to the Student Service Center) serves fresh meals, tea, and snacks daily from 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM.
